Click to hide this leader's line.
Click to show this leader's line.
Each leader's {1_Yield} per turn, recorded every turn of the game.
When each leader founded, captured, lost, razed or upgraded settlements.

Every [B]Settlement[/B] a leader gains, loses or upgrades.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: gold for a City, blue for a Town; green when captured, red when lost, purple when razed[LI][B]Dot[/B]: Founded (or Incorporated), Captured, Lost, Razed or Upgraded to City[LI][B]Dashed Arc[/B]: joins a Town to its upgrade, and a capture or loss to its razing[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: Settlements held now (or at the end of the Age); Cities and Towns on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: urbanization, the share of developed tiles that are urban (buildings, wonders and fortifications, against improvements); the most urbanized and the most rural Settlement on hover (current Age).
When each leader's settlements grew, in urban, rural and specialist citizens.

Every citizen a leader's Settlements gain.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: the building or improvement that added it, in the color of its main yield[LI][B]Dot[/B]: gold for urban, silver for rural[LI][B]Specialist[/B]: a glowing gold pin, with the buildings on its tile[/LIST][NN]A captured Settlement counts from its size when taken.[NN][B]Total[/B]: citizens now (or at the end of the Age); urban, rural and specialists on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: specialists; by Settlement and Quarter on hover.
Each leader's share of the world's military strength (the combat strength of every leader's units), recorded every turn of the game.
When each leader produced, purchased or was granted units, and which.

Every unit a leader [B]produces[/B], [B]purchases[/B] or is [B]granted[/B].[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: land, naval, civilian or commander[LI][B]Commanders[/B]: counted once, not again when they return after defeat[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: units trained; each category on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: each commander type trained, otherwise the most-trained unit; every unit by category on hover.
When each leader lost units to destruction or capture, and to whom.

Every unit a leader loses to an enemy, destroyed or captured.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: land, naval, civilian or commander, and who took it[LI][B]Rank[/B]: fewest lost first[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: units lost; each category on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: each commander type lost, otherwise the most-lost unit; every unit by category on hover.
When each leader destroyed or captured units, and which.

Every enemy unit a leader destroys or captures.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: land, naval, civilian or commander, and whose it was[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: units defeated; each category on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: each commander type defeated, otherwise the most-defeated unit; every unit by category on hover.
When each leader's commanders earned promotions and commendations, and which.

Every [B]Promotion[/B] and [B]Commendation[/B] a leader's commanders earn.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Promotion[/B]: its tree's icon, on a pin in the tree's color[LI][B]Commendation[/B]: its icon, on a glowing gold pin[LI][B]Detail[/B]: the commander, and which of its promotions it was[LI][B]Dashed Arc[/B]: joins each commander's promotions; the dot's color tells commanders apart[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: Promotions and Commendations; each on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: the most-earned Commendation and the most-promoted tree; each Commendation and tree on hover.
When each leader was at war, with whom, and how each war began and ended.

Wars between leaders; Independent Powers are always hostile and do not count. A war carries on into a new Age until peace is made.[NN]The notches show each turn:[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Red[/B]: Aggression, the leader declared the war[LI][B]Yellow[/B]: Defense, war was declared on the leader[LI][B]Gray[/B]: At Peace[/LIST][NN]Wars going on at once share a notch; a peace made fills its notch in green. A pin showing the enemy marks where each war began, and a [B]green[/B] pin where peace was made; each names who attacked whom.[NN][B]Turns[/B]: turns at war; wars declared, declared on and peace made on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: the enemy it was at war with longest (all of them when tied); every war on hover.
When each leader fought sieges, battles and skirmishes, against whom, and what was captured, razed or pillaged.

A leader's conflicts. An [B]engagement[/B] is every attack and pillage between the same two sides within 3 tiles, with no more than 5 turns between them. It counts once both sides have attacked each other with units that can fight (not settlers or scouts); each attack counts for both sides, and pillage counts 2 for a building and 1 for a rural tile.[NN]In order of priority:[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Razed[/B]: a Settlement razed, once gone from the map[LI][B]Captured[/B]: a Settlement taken[LI][B]Lost[/B]: a Settlement taken from the leader[LI][B]Siege[/B]: a Settlement besieged; besieged again by the same enemy within 5 turns, it is the same siege[LI][B]Battle[/B]: an engagement with 3 or more attacks or 4 or more pillage on its first turn or once it has lasted 3 turns, with fighting on 5 turns, or with a siege between the two sides[LI][B]Skirmish[/B]: any smaller engagement[LI][B]Pillaged[/B]: a tile pillaged by an enemy unit, not by floods, eruptions or storms; [B]Was Pillaged[/B], the leader's own tiles, counts here too[/LIST][NN]A dot shows the opponent: gold for a leader, blue for a City-State, silver for an Independent Power; a pin leads with a leader, then a City-State, then an Independent Power. The notches show each siege (orange), battle (red) and skirmish (blue) while it goes on; where they overlap they share the notch, the first taking most of it. A dashed arc joins each to what it followed from: a Skirmish to the Battle it became, the fighting to a Siege, a Siege to a capture or loss, and that to its razing.[NN][B]Total[/B]: sieges, battles, skirmishes and pillage; on hover, apart from them, their outcomes: razings, captures and losses.[N][B]Card[/B]: the Nemesis, the player fought most (leaders before City-States and Independent Powers); every other opponent on hover.
